request.query: Family member's residence (EU registration or residence card of a family member of an EU citizen)

sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: Your family members must register their stay or notify the authorities of their residence in Finland
They must visit the Finnish Immigration Service in person to prove their identity

sources.title: enterfinland.fi
highlights: You must apply for registration of your right of residence in Finland if you reside in Finland for over 3 months and are a citizen of an EU Member State, Liechtenstein or Switzerland

sources.title: enterfinland.fi
highlights: A valid passport or identity card
When you apply for EU registration as a family member: a document that proves your family ties and documents confirming that the sponsor (your family member) meets the requirements for registration

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: If your attachments are not in Finnish, Swedish or English, they must be accompanied by a translation into one of these languages by an authorised translator
If you meet the requirements for registration and have presented the necessary attachments, you can get a registration certificate immediately when you visit a service point to prove your identity
Book an appointment in our appointment system (migri.vihta.com) to visit a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service

sources.title: byteseu.com
highlights: I changed my application to this and it was approved within a few days
They informed me that it would be better for me to apply for a Residency Permit for a family member of an EU citizen in Finland
This permit has not come up on any of my searches and it was not obvious to me
